text: England beat Australia by seven wickets (DLS) in the third T20I as Jamie Overton took a career-best 5 for 12, and lead the series 2-1.
Gukesh and Sindarov drew Game 3 in 60 moves to level the world championship at 1.5-1.5, with Game 4 on Saturday after a rest day.
Bears beat the Lions 39-35 after Rome Odunze's touchdown with three seconds left, taking the NFC North lead at 9-2.
The UK Championship snooker opens in York on Saturday with sessions at 1 PM and 7 PM UK time.
The Players Championship Finals start in Minehead without defending champion Luke Littler, who did not qualify; Stephen Bunting v Max Hopp closes Friday's evening Stage Two.
Charley Hull's Atlanta Drive lost 8-3 to Lottie Woad's Boston Common in the WTGL, though Hull won her singles against Celine Boutier.
Arthur Rinderknech denies refusing an anti-doping test in June after the ITIA confirmed a charge, and has requested an independent tribunal hearing.
